subject: Request: Self-serve credits for new PLG signup - BrightByte
messages:
From: Elliot Marsh <elliot@brightbyte.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: free credits for trial — new sign-up (BrightByte)

Hi Jordan,

We just signed up for Redwood last night (using company email elliot@brightbyte.ai) and are kicking off an internal POC to evaluate chat copilots for our analytics dashboard. The self-serve signup completed but we hit the token limits while smoke-testing prompts.

Could you expedite a small credit grant so our engineers can finish the initial evaluation this week? Quick details below:
- Org: BrightByte (Series A, ~18 engineers)
- Use: POC — intent classification + summarization, low concurrency, testing with a 2k token context
- Preferred models: open llama and gpt-compat when available

I attached a copy of the signup form and a screenshot of the usage error. Happy to provide any additional verification.

Thanks,
Elliot Marsh
Head of Product
BrightByte
elliot@brightbyte.ai

Attachments: signup-form.json, usage-screenshot.png
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Marsh <elliot@brightbyte.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: free credits for trial — new sign-up (BrightByte)

Hi Elliot — welcome and thanks for the quick context. Glad to hear the POC is moving fast. I can triage this immediately.

A couple quick clarifying items so I route to the right queue:
1) Are you testing primarily via the Playground or via API keys from the dashboard?
2) Rough expected consumption for the next 30 days (tokens / month) — ballpark is fine.
3) Any procurement requirements (PO, billing email) we should know about now?

If this is purely self-serve POC work and you need to finish integration this week, we typically expedite a 15k token starter grant for 30 days. Ben — looping you in for approval. Monica in CS can complete issuance once we have an ok.

If you can reply with the two bullets above I’ll push it through.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

I've issued 15,000 token credits to your account (elliot@brightbyte.ai). Promo code: RB-FASTLANE-15000. Valid for 30 days from issuance. You should see the credit balance in the Dashboard > Billing > Credits immediately.

Monica Patel
